annotations.title: Hand WhatsApp conversation back to agent

description:
Give the conversation back to the agent, and clear a pause. The agent
answers the customer's next message. Repeating it changes nothing.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

conversation_id.description:
A conversation id: the number id, a dash, then the customer's phone
digits, such as `412-919876543210`. From
[listWhatsappConversations](/docs/api-reference/whatsapp/listWhatsappConversations).

name: handBackWhatsappConversation
